name: Phantom Armor Tetra: Bio-juu ni Yugame-fukuramasareru Botebara to Bakunyuu no Kyoufu!
original_name: 霊甲テトラ　バイオ獣に歪め膨らまされるッボテ腹と爆乳の恐怖！
source:
A scientist of "LTE," Neon Lebianna, has taken the captain of the Glams military group that is attacking the earth as her prisoner and is determined to make her into a test subject. She conducts various experiments on her body; however, after being attacked, she now becomes captive with a super powered humanoid Tetra!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ049135.html]DLsite English[/url]]
